correctness.rationale: Every ideal is preserved by the orthomorphism; finite permutations then force class preservation for the complete map itself. The rectangular-class two-permutation-family normal form is a bijection in both directions and proves the uniform fiber, count and cycle-index identity. Seven direct Cayley-table examples exhaust 41,952 input permutations and agree, without being used as a general proof.

value.rationale: The complete class of finite bands has a natural Cayley-table transversal/complete mapping invariant and orthomorphism cycle distribution. The theorem gives a closed exact all-band enumeration and explains its surprising independence from multiplication between different rectangular components. It also resolves the orthomorphism-only part of an explicit recent cycle-structure problem; it does not claim a paper-sized advance or solve the joint-cycle question.
